Ferntree Rainforest Lodge is a family-owned, eco friendly resort set on 28 acres in Cape Tribulation . Our Daintree rainforest retreat offers air-conditioned, self-contained cabins and lofts, surrounded by lush tropical gardens.
Unwind at our on-site bar and restaurant, take a refreshing dip in our nature pool, and let our tour desk guide your next adventure in the world’s oldest rainforest.
Discover our Daintree Rainforest accommodation . We welcome adventurers, nature lovers and travellers seeking an extraordinary escape off the beaten path.
While not a 5-star luxury resort, we provide modern comforts in a breathtaking, remote rainforest setting.

About
Ferntree Rainforest Lodge
Daintree Rainforest Accommodation
Ferntree Rainforest Lodge is a family-owned and off-grid rainforest resort set on a 28-acre property in enchanting Cape Tribulation — where two World Heritage Sites meet: the Daintree Rainforest and the Great Barrier Reef.
About Us
Not a tropical island with umbrella drinks—this is the Daintree Rainforest, and it's even better.
If you're the kind of traveller who craves adventure, connection, and wild natural beauty, you've just hit the jackpot at our Cape Tribulation accommodation . Nestled in the heart of the world’s oldest rainforest, our charming resort is your gateway to unforgettable experiences.
Swap the usual holiday routine for something extraordinary: think rainforest walks, enchanting tropical beaches, hidden swimming holes, local wildlife encounters, and the kind of serenity only the Daintree can offer. With a warm local team and a laid-back vibe, staying at Ferntree Rainforest Lodge is your Daintree home away from home.
BOOK NOW
OUR ROOMS
Explore
It’s not about luxury - it’s about heart, nature and authentic rainforest vibes.
After a day of exploring, retreat to your comfy room - equipped with air-conditioning, ceiling fans, and a private balcony overlooking lush tropical flora (and maybe a curious cassowary or two!). Prefer to DIY dinner? Our self-contained cabins with kitchenettes are perfect for 2 to 5 hungry explorers ready to cook up a storm.
And yes—we’ve got the largest swimming pool in Cape Tribulation , ideal for a refreshing dip before dinner at our fabulous Cassowary Restaurant and Bar , where you’ll find hearty meals, cold brews, and a friendly crowd. Want more? Join us for our legendary NIGHTWALKS and see the rainforest come alive after dark.

FAQs
Have questions? Browse through our FAQs below — and if you don’t see what you’re looking for, feel free to get in touch . We’re always happy to help.
Do you offer a discount for staying in your resorts for long periods?
Yes, we do - the longer you stay, the greater the discount! We offer several packages such as a 20% discount deal off your 2nd night when booking a 2-night stay. When booking 3 nights you will receive a 50% discount on your 3rd night, and our most popular deal offered is our "Stay 4 Nights Receive the 4th Night Free"-deal - when booking 4 nights of stay with us you will receive your 4th night free! Please have a look at "Deals" to read more about what option suits your planned holiday best.
How do I know that my reservation is confirmed?
You will receive a confirmation email in your inbox of the email address provided once the reservation is confirmed. Please double check you have entered the correct email address before confirming your reservation. If you have made a booking with us but have not yet received your confirmation email, please contact our friendly customer service team by email on  bookings@ferntreelodge.com  or by phone on #07 4098 0000.
What happens if I want to cancel my room reservation?
We understand sometimes unforeseen circumstances occur. Therefore, we offer a great 72-hour cancellation policy within our property. You can cancel or amend your reservation free of charge until 72 hours (3 days) prior to your booked arrival date. If you amend or cancel your booking within 72 hours of your arrival date, there will be a late cancellation fee applied. In case of a no-show, the full booking amount will be charged.
Can I book a hotel room by telephone or email?
Absolutely! You are welcome to contact our friendly customer service team directly by email on  bookings@ferntreelodge.com  or by phone on #07 4098 0000 to book your stay with us. We are happy to help with planning your activities for your stay as well - ask us about the tours offered from here and we will help you make your stay the most memorable experience in our very special area of the world!
What are the check-in and check-out times of the hotel?
Check-in is available from 2:00 pm onwards. An early check-in is possible upon request in advance but cannot be guaranteed. Please advise us if you are expecting to arrive earlier in the day and we will do our absolute best to accommodate your request. Check-out time is 10:00 am. Late check-outs are also possible upon request in advance but as mentioned above, this cannot be guaranteed. Please see our friendly front desk team at Reception during your stay and we will be able to advise whether we can accommodate your request of a late check-out.

Getting to Ferntree Rainforest Lodge
Daintree Rainforest Accommodation
Nestled in the heart of the Daintree, Ferntree Rainforest Lodge offers an unbeatable location at Cape Tribulation. Surrounded by lush rainforest, we re just a short stroll from the beach and close to local convenience stores, cafés, restaurants, and tour operators — everything you need for the perfect getaway.
Arriving at our Daintree Rainforst sanctuary
Take the cable ferry to cross the Daintree River and continue your journey north.
Crossing the river on the Daintree Ferry is part of the adventure — a step into a world straight out of Jurassic times! The cable ferry takes around five minutes to carry you across the Daintree River and operates continuously from 5 am to midnight every day.
Once across, a sealed road provides easy 2WD access all the way to Cape Tribulation.
For those with a 4WD, the adventure can also continue north along the iconic Bloomfield Track toward Cape York.
Guests to our Daintree Rainforest retreat can enjoy the comforts of air-conditioned rooms, self-contained facilities, our large swimming pool for cooling down after a warm tropical day and the convenience of our onsite Cassowary Bar & Restaurant - all nestled in an ideal location in Cape Tribulation .
We also offer a range of tours and experiences for guests to book and enjoy during their stay. From guided rainforest walks, snorkelling tours, zipline tours, tropical fruit tasting experiences, day trips to Cooktown and more.
We look forward to welcoming you to Ferntree Rainforest Lodge .
